name: font-satoshi
title: Satoshi Variable (Lumen single typeface)
description: Self-hosted Satoshi Variable + Italic — the only typeface in the Lumen system (ITF-FFL: free for commercial use; do not redistribute the font files in any public repo). Variable axis 300–900 covers UI, display, numerics (tnum + zero on), and code (mono-tracked cap variant). Shadcn 4 `registry:font` is google-fonts-only; Satoshi is self-hosted, so we ship as `registry:lib` with the woff2 files + a sibling @font-face declaration baked into `@lumen/tokens`.
